_comment: CLEAN-1 (LIC-1 S8): files an older KiraPick installer put in the installation folder that this version does not ship and that must not stay. Exact paths only, no wildcard, so a file the user put there is never touched (user data lives in %LOCALAPPDATA%\KiraPick, not here). Source: inventory of the published v3.0.0 / v3.0.0a installers (CI run 42199575662) and of v0.2.0b1..v2.2.1 (runs 42208112442, 42245312724, 42245711312), which use the same file names. packaging/installer.iss [InstallDelete] must list exactly these (tests/unit/test_packaging.py).
